name: Shadow on the Bridge
source:
Life is all about meetings and events. And sometimes one little event can cause a chain that changes the very direction of your life. This is the story of one guy's encounter with a girl standing on a bridge. And how both of their lives changed due to this one event.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14677]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
